attacks.name: Soulsword
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Bolts of Oshtur
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!critical| |!wild| |*Hex|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§hex§Hex| special condition.

attacks.name: Darkchylde
steps: When calculating successes for this attack, this character adds the number of |!failure| results in both the attack and defense rolls to its total successes.
After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| and |§incinerate§Incinerate| special conditions.

superPowers.name: Limbo Step
superPowers.body: This character may spend 1 to 3 |!power| to use this superpower. Place this character within |!range| X of its current position, where X is the amount of |!power| spent. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Scrying Mirrors of Limbo
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!mystic| attack, for each |!wild| in the defense roll, it may change 1 of the attacker's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!hit| results to a Blank. This character gains 1 |!power| for each die changed in this way.
